title: A quest-linked dialogue option kept firing after its quest was already resolved through a different path, and produced a contradictory extra outcome. I settled 'The Mission's Order' peacefully via the Envoy option 'make the maths simple for her' with Warder Iss (she stood the Ironbound mission down, took the arithmetic, gave gold, Church +1). The Priory's 'tell Halm what the Ironbound mean to do' option was still on the menu afterward; selecting it caused Halm to have the Ironbound forcibly walked off Stilt Row ('Not in my water'), adding another Ironbound -2 on top of an already-peaceful resolution.
where: The Priory of the Gray Church / action 'tell Halm what the Ironbound mean to do'
